Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 8, 2024

Hi Linda, thank you for your feedback and we are so incredibly sorry to hear about your shopping experience with us. Apologies for the inconveniences caused by not receiving the tracking information for the pillow prior to it shipping out. We hope that we will be able to make up for this next time around, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
